name: Transfer of Certified Disciplinary Record
description: When a student transfers out, the District sends a certified copy of the disciplinary record, plus a copy of any juvenile probation notice, to the receiving school.
deadline: within ten (10) days of receiving the request
quote: When a student transfers from a District school to another school district, a nonpublic school or other school within the District, the District shall transmit a certified copy of the student’s disciplinary record within ten (10) days of receiving the request from the school to which the student has transferred.
